# Poe2ClockAccessor

[API index](../index)

Live script-facing wrapper over [`Poe2Game::clock`].

## NowTicks

```typescript
NowTicks: number;
```

Game-clock "now", in TICKS (100 ns units — the .NET `TimeSpan`/`Stopwatch` tick, NOT a game
frame). Time-base: the managed game clock, which advances once per game REFRESH; it does NOT
advance while the script is Automation-gated (Automation off / window background), because a gated refresh
still ticks the game clock but the SCRIPT tick — the only place a script observes this value —
is skipped, so from the script's perspective the reading is frozen at the last active tick.
`0` when the game is detached.

## DeltaTicks

```typescript
DeltaTicks: number;
```

The most recent frame delta, in TICKS (100 ns units). Time-base: game clock; frozen while
Automation-gated (see [`Self::NowTicks`]). `0` when detached.

## StartedAtTicks

```typescript
StartedAtTicks: number;
```

The tick value captured when the game clock STARTED, in TICKS (100 ns units). Time-base: game
clock (a fixed epoch, so it does not move with gating). `0` when detached.

## ActualTicks

```typescript
ActualTicks: number;
```

The ACTUAL wall-clock "now", in TICKS (100 ns units), read straight from the underlying
stopwatch — unlike [`Self::NowTicks`] it is NOT the frame-quantized game clock and keeps
advancing even while Automation-gated. `0` when detached.

## NowMs

```typescript
NowMs: number;
```

Game-clock "now", in MILLISECONDS (fractional). Time-base: the game clock, which advances once
per game REFRESH; frozen from the script's view while Automation-gated (Automation off / window background) —
the gated tick is skipped, so a script re-observes the same value across gated ticks. This is
the same time-base the rule engine uses for cooldowns / `SinceLastActivation`, which likewise
only advance on ticks that actually run. `0.0` when detached.

## CurrentTickMs

```typescript
CurrentTickMs: number;
```

Alias of [`Self::NowMs`] — the current game-clock time in MILLISECONDS. Same time-base and
same Automation-gated freeze behavior.

## DeltaMs

```typescript
DeltaMs: number;
```

The most recent frame delta, in MILLISECONDS (fractional). Time-base: game clock; a gated tick
contributes no observable delta to a script (the tick is skipped). `0.0` when detached.

## ToMs

```typescript
ToMs(ticks: number): number;
```

Convert a game-clock TICK count (100 ns units) to MILLISECONDS (fractional). Pure conversion —
no live clock read, so unaffected by Automation gating. `0.0` when detached.

## ActualElapsedMs

```typescript
ActualElapsedMs(sinceTicks: number): number;
```

ACTUAL wall-clock milliseconds elapsed since `sinceTicks` (a value from [`Self::ActualTicks`]),
in MILLISECONDS (fractional). Time-base: the underlying stopwatch, so — unlike the game-clock
members — it keeps measuring real time even while Automation-gated. `0.0` when detached.
